extraction.summary_en: This filing is an extract of an AGE (20 May 2011) of ARCHEAN TECHNOLOGIES that only changes the fiscal year-end date (article 20 of the statutes) and grants powers for formalities. It contains no resolution or statement about share capital or shareholders beyond the letterhead mention of the capital amount (368,102 euros), which per instructions is not a snapshot.
